SOURCE-ONLY implementation handoff for be627c0e-b85b-4f4f-8b07-88ee651038c1. Published origin/codex/document-save-owned-presenter head93244f8f from exact baseline010617b8. Tests-first commits3a7c0d1c,b3277f15,98141b95,c3de5e08,412654d0,84dc314c; production8fd107f5; handoff93244f8f. All UNRUN on B; no builds/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart. No product acceptance claimed. Apply contiguous range after010617b8; tests depend on new API, so standalone test commits are not compilable baseline gates. Historical baseline's explicit unseen-lifetime test can establish behavioral RED; migrated test retains actual successor outcome without view events, no skip/expected-failure.

Fresh bridge bindingUUID plus parent identity protects same-window rebind from stale update/dismantle; old-window close also identity guarded. Form/Replace own separate native invocation tokens. Completion joins captured parent's attachedSheet AND sheets-membership clearance. End only captured sheet; reentrant cancel/completion latched. Child chooser cancel targets captured NSOpenPanel, parent end waits actual child return. Weak workspace actions; bounded drain context releases callbacks/observers/hosting/window on retirement. Exact host loss after form drain marks running writer continuation cancelled while retaining actual write result. Opening/load/status/activation and legacy write/export/close regions confirmed byte-identical to010617b8. ContentView only replaces Save As modifier; no AppModel/theme/other sheet changes.

Explicit unresolved native contract gate: SDK NSWindow.h578-602 verifies sheets includes queued entries, but header/Apple endSheet docs do not explicitly guarantee queued-only endSheet completion. Fake membership tests are NOT native proof. A must validate ending the exact owned queued sheet behind unrelated captured sheet, actual owned completion and membership removal, unrelated unchanged; also parent-close/nested chooser drain and release. If AppKit does not complete/remove, current design intentionally holds one context; report design gap rather than clearing on absence/parent event/timer. No leak-free guarantee before these gates. This is the requested notification of native contract limit, not weakened safety/liveness or a synthetic proof.

Full implementation map, lifetime assumptions, test migration and required GUI acceptance: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/DOCUMENT-SAVE-OWNED-PRESENTER-HANDOFF.md at93244f8f. Durable wp/B5-16 note updated/pushedcd844534. git diff --check passes only. Existing e51 GUI failure retained. A sole compiler/GUI/main integrator; B hold intact.
